ksbs.description: Automotive refinish materials, including fillers, primers, basecoats and clearcoats, and how application technique affects quality.
Drying and curing methods used in vehicle refinishing, including booth bake, infrared, UV and catalytic systems.
Paint repair tools, equipment and devices, including spray guns, nozzles, mixing schemes, paint booths and UV lamps.
Substrate types such as steel, aluminium, plastic, GRP and carbon fibre, and how substrate affects process and material selection.
Safe handling and significant risks linked to solvents, high-voltage components, conventional and alternative-fuelled vehicles.
Paint volume estimation, mixing ratios, viscosity, waste control and job-based material planning.
Health, safety and compliance requirements of a collision repair business, including COSHH and environmental responsibilities.
Commercial productivity, cycle time, efficiency, waste, defect prevention and the impact of rework on resources and reputation.
Quality control processes and the implications of poor quality repairs for safety, customer satisfaction and business outcomes.
Prepare the job and work area before repair, including safe setup, job documentation, materials and panel preparation.
Correctly identify substrate materials and select a suitable refinish route.
Interpret technical data, paint manufacturer methods and repair information to create the correct application process.
Use refinish materials to manufacturer specification to reinstate the vehicle finish to a high standard.
Identify, select and operate the correct repair tools, equipment and devices for the paint repair process.
Work safely and efficiently while following business operating procedures and policies.
Work as an effective team member, take responsibility, be honest and keep others informed if deadlines are at risk.
Seek opportunities to learn about the wider collision repair business.
Show commitment to customer service, deadlines and flexible support for business goals.
Take responsibility for personal and professional development, including emerging technology awareness.
Anticipate problems, put controls in place and address root causes when issues occur.
Communicate effectively with customers and colleagues.
